metadata.title: feat(ui-rewrite): MCP server edit mode, OAuth password grant validation, auth type refactoring
metadata.author: marekdano

description:
Related #4176 

### Summary

  - Implements edit mode for the MCP server form — editing an existing server pre-populates all fields from the API, submitting sends a PUT, and the servers table refreshes on success
  - Adds validation for OAuth password grant (username and password required before submit is enabled)
  - Refactors auth type mapping and OAuth config schema for correctness and maintainability
  - Fixes E2E CI workflow: Playwright browser install steps now run from ./client
  - 115 unit/integration tests covering all new paths; removes two unused components

---
###  Changes

  Edit mode (Servers.tsx, MCPServerForm.tsx, useMCPServerForm.ts)

  - MCPServerForm gains serverId and onSuccess props; the hook accepts gatewayId and fetches /gateways/:id when set, populating all form fields on load — basic fields, auth credentials, custom headers, OAuth config, passthrough headers,
  advanced settings
  - handleEdit in Servers.tsx was a throwing stub; it now sets updateServerId, opens the pre-populated form, and passes onSuccess to refetch the table and close
  - If the server fetch fails in edit mode, a red error banner is shown above the form instead of silently presenting an empty form

  OAuth password grant validation (useMCPServerForm.ts, OAuth2Auth.tsx, AdvancedSettings.tsx)

  - superRefine on the Zod schema requires oauthUsername and oauthPassword when grant_type === "password"
  - isValid memo also guards the submit button before parse
  - OAuth2Auth renders inline error messages under username/password with aria-invalid and aria-describedby wiring; AdvancedSettings and MCPServerForm thread the error props through

  Auth type mapping (useMCPServerForm.ts)

  - AUTH_TYPE_TO_API and AUTH_TYPE_FROM_API module-level constants replace two inline expressions; Record<AuthType, string> ensures TypeScript catches any missing variant when a new auth type is added

  OAuth config type safety (useMCPServerForm.ts)

  - oauthConfigSchema (typed Zod object with grant_type enum, boolean flags, typed string fields) replaces z.record(z.unknown())

  Masked value sentinel (useMCPServerForm.ts)

  - === "*****" replaces /^\*+$/ — matches the exact backend contract rather than any run of asterisks

  CI fix (.github/workflows/client-e2e.yml)

  - Added working-directory: ./client to both Playwright browser install steps; previously they ran from the repo root where playwright is not installed, causing "Executable doesn't exist" failures

 ### Removed

  - ServersEmptyState.tsx and GatewayIcon.tsx — neither was imported anywhere

  Tests (MCPServerForm.test.tsx, useMCPServerForm.test.ts, setup.ts)

  - setup.ts: four jsdom stubs required by Radix UI Select (hasPointerCapture, setPointerCapture, releasePointerCapture, scrollIntoView)
  - MCPServerForm.test.tsx: 20 custom-headers integration tests with an addHeaders(user, count) helper; 9 OAuth password grant tests using a renderWithOAuthPassword helper that drives the Radix UI Select to switch grant types
  - useMCPServerForm.test.ts: edit mode population via MSW, auth type round-trip mapping, masked sentinel handling, OAuth config serialisation per grant type, cross-field validation (115 tests total)

  ---
###  Test plan

  - Create a new MCP server — form submits and appears in the table
  - Edit an existing server — form opens pre-populated, submit sends PUT, table refreshes
  - Edit a server with OAuth password grant — username and password are required; submit is disabled until both are filled
  - Simulate a failed server fetch in edit mode — error banner appears above the form
  - E2E workflow passes without "Executable doesn't exist" error

commits.message:
fix(ui): resolve TypeScript errors in useMCPServerForm from OAuth grant-type work

- Split mcpServerFormSchema into mcpServerFormObjectSchema (ZodObject) and
  mcpServerFormSchema (ZodEffects) so validateField can access .shape —
  ZodEffects produced by .superRefine does not expose .shape
- Remove grant_type from the shared base object and set the string literal
  in each grant-type branch so TS narrows correctly against the Zod enum
  ("client_credentials" | "authorization_code" | "password") without widening
  to string

Signed-off-by: Marek Dano <Marek.Dano@ibm.com>
